notes: Retake (draft): Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B redoes a stretch of a clip. The control video holds the real frames around the stretch and grey in it; the mask is white where to paint. Prospero builds both with ffmpeg, then splices the new stretch back into the clip at its own fps. 832x480 (or the clip's orientation) at 16 fps, length 4n+1 up to 81. Built from the core WanVaceToVideo node as in the official VACE inpainting template.
